stem: Which of the following leaders presided over the Congress Session at Calcutta in 1906?
expl: In 1906, the Calcutta session of the Indian National Congress was presided over by Dadabhai Naoroji. In this session, resolutions related to Swaraj/Self-rule, Swadeshi, Boycott, and National Education were passed, and the flag of Swaraj was hoisted by Dadabhai Naoroji.
